catalysts.headline: GPRO up 11% to $1.57 intraday; commentary frames this as possibly speculative/meme-driven rather than merger-arbitrage, since it traded above the pending deal's $1.14 cash value

GoPro announces definitive merger agreement with Starman Optical: GoPro shareholders get an aggregate $285M cash ($1.14/share) plus ~10% of the combined company; GoPro's ~$92M debt repaid at closing; pivot toward AI/defense optics; expected to close by year-end 2026
catalysts.impact: major re-rating event for a distressed name

catalysts.headline: YouTube personality Markiplier (Mark Fischbach) disclosed an 8.5% stake in GoPro, becoming its largest shareholder; he described the stock as cheap and the stake as a personal project to help the company turn around
catalysts.impact: closed +46.06% (some sources report +43.5%/+46%) on ~142.5M shares traded, roughly 20x the prior 5-day average

catalysts.headline: Bloomberg reports YouTube creator Mark Fischbach ('Markiplier') disclosed an 8.5% passive stake (13.5M Class A shares) via Schedule 13G filed 2026-08-20

Q2 2026: revenue $105M (-31% Y/Y), GAAP net loss $51M / -$0.30 EPS, adjusted EPS -$0.21 vs -$0.08 Y/Y; also received a Nasdaq notice for non-compliance with the minimum bid price requirement (180-day grace period)
GoPro files 8-K disclosing 'substantial doubt' about its ability to continue as a going concern; PwC adds explanatory paragraph
catalysts.impact: shares fell as much as 12% intraday
